issue: Matching strata include a required_last_year threshold. Some other-domestic records can appear in more than one threshold-defined reference risk set.
correction: The exactHHI computation defines independent finite draws within each conditional risk set. It is not a single globally consistent label permutation across mutually disjoint strata, and it is not a randomized-treatment null.
numerical_expectation: Unchanged and verified relative to the explicitly independent-stratum resampling design.
reporting: Use conditional matched resampling reference, avoid claims of a global exact permutation test or causal effect.
